feed.title: NPR Topics: World
feed.subtitle: International news, global reporting and analysis from NPR. Plus dispatches from NPR’s State of the World podcast.

entry.title: Russell Brand to learn sentence after being found guilty of rape and sexual assault
entry.summary: Comedian Brand faces a "significant" prison sentence, which a London court judge is set to hand down on Monday.

entry.title: A desert stirs to life: Chile's Atacama erupts in its biggest floral display in decades
entry.summary: El Niño rains have transformed Chile's Atacama Desert into a spectacular sea of color, awakening a fleeting ecosystem of flowers and wildlife in one of the driest places on Earth.

entry.title: Israeli president invites Netanyahu's opposition leader to broker new government
entry.summary: Israel's political landscape shifts as President Herzog hands opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot the mandate to form a government, dealing a blow to Benjamin Netanyahu's grip on power.

entry.title: A correspondent finds Cuba's people struggling
entry.summary: Reporting from Cuba comes with distinct challenges especially amid widespread power outages and fuel shortages.

entry.title: Israel's president taps opposition candidate, not Netanyahu, to form a government
entry.summary: Gadi Eisenkot ran as the main rival to Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, but neither won enough support to command a majority. Israel's main parties have recommended Eisenkot form a new government.

entry.title: Ousted Paraguayan president appears before prosecutors
entry.summary: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña was removed from office and placed under house arrest Friday. The Senate voted on his impeachment after the collapse of a state-affiliated bank.

entry.title: Israel's Arab-led parties in spotlight after inconclusive election
entry.summary: Israel's center-right opposition has a chance to unseat Netanyahu — but backing of Arab-led parties will be key.

entry.title: Pope Leo begins a 12-day, 3-country South America tour after his cancer surgery
entry.summary: Pope Leo begins his first South American tour since lung cancer surgery. The 12-day journey takes him to Uruguay, Argentina and Peru, where he spent two decades.

entry.title: Health intel-sharing group warns industry in wake of cyberattack on French blood bank
entry.summary: A healthcare intelligence-sharing organization is warning its members to lock down systems following cyberattacks on cold storage systems, including a French blood bank.

entry.title: European flights and broadcasters are targeted with another wave of bomb threats
entry.summary: Officials across Europe reported a slew of bomb threats against multiple flights, following a string of hoaxes that caused flight diversions this week. Three broadcasters also received threats.
